name: Supreme Petrochem Ltd
title: Supreme Petrochem Ltd - 500405 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 volumes up 5.4% and EBITDA margin 15.9% on inventory-heavy March pricing; management refuses to quantify inventory gains/losses, ABS running at 65% of design, and FY27 volume guidance of 8-10% is conditional on normalcy by June.

utilisation.quote: currently operating at around 65% of the design capacity, pending restoration of the impacted equipment

capex.peers_comment: Haryana PS/EPS spend deferred until IOC styrene monomer plant commissioning date is clear
capex.quote: we are not committing any expense for that at the moment

triggers.label: ABS running at 65% of design
triggers.quote: currently operating at around 65% of the design capacity, pending restoration of the impacted equipment

triggers.label: Haryana PS/EPS capex deferred
triggers.quote: we are not committing any expense for that at the moment

triggers.label: Non-OEM demand hit in April
triggers.quote: the demand from the OEM sectors is good, but in the non-OEM sector, the demand has taken a big beating

triggers.label: FY27 volume growth 8-10%, conditional
triggers.quote: if everything becomes normal by June end and July sees the normal behavior in the global market, we should be doing 8% to 10% volume growth this year

triggers.label: Inventory gain/loss unquantifiable
triggers.quote: it's very difficult to estimate the gains or the inventory gain or loss at the moment

guidance.quote: we should be doing 8% to 10% volume growth this year
for the Company as a whole, we will be doing around Rs.250 crores
we expect that we should be able to do close to 85%, 90% or 80% of that capacity this year now
this year, we should be doing close to say 70% of that capacity or 65 to 70% of that capacity

red_flags.label: Inventory gains/losses unquantifiable; SM bought at high prices
red_flags.quote: we are aware that inventory loss might come the moment the whole situation normalizes

red_flags.label: Debtors INR 520 cr; working capital rising
red_flags.quote: I see a bit of higher working capital investment, largely driven by higher debtor, INR 520 crores as of 31st March

evasions.quote: it's very difficult to estimate the gains or the inventory gain or loss at the moment

evasions.topic: Raw material sourcing mix (Gulf vs China vs US)
evasions.quote: we source some from Asia and from China at the moment
